The second reference contains cropped appearance details only, without a competing body pose. No extra hands, boots, isolated limb bits, ghosting or overlapping cells.

These are the actual low-front beginning of a crane, so the elevation changes are small, never a leap to overhead or a new camera yaw. Preserve face/head/shoulder size, costume palette and natural proportions throughout. Cool silver night lighting with existing restrained warm rim. All four complete figures have uniform physical scale and enough empty space in their own equal cells for sword, shield, hair and boots. No ground, shadows, labels, numbers, borders, grid, text or background.
